pageTitle: Public toilets and drinking water in Tokyo
metaDescription: 20,972 practical places mapped in Tokyo: 2,552 public toilets, 1,591 drinking water points, 5,394 places to park. Free on iOS and Android.
heroTitle: Public toilets and drinking water in Tokyo
heroLead: Voyager Maps has 20,972 practical places mapped in Tokyo — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.
statsIntro: How many of each kind of place the map currently holds in Tokyo. These are mapped locations, not an estimate of every one that exists — coverage comes from OpenStreetMap and grows as people add to it.
ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Tokyo on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Tokyo
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Tokyo it currently holds 2,552 public toilets and 1,591 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: 1,048 of the 20,972 places mapped in Tokyo are recorded as free of charge.
